title: the pre-commit gate's doctor refuses every commit from a linked worktree: the tree function's git spawn into the install tree inherits the hook's absolute GIT_DIR and reads the wrong repository
body:
Found by molt-cc and reproduced by molt-vc in a Molt worktree on 2026-10-25, reproduced here by vc the same afternoon on the installed pair at 128c58669, the first pair carrying ST0087 WP-01; filed by vc. It blocks every gated commit made from a linked worktree while Intent runs from its dev tree, which is every estate under hv's ruling of today that branch work goes in worktrees, so it is in 3.2.7 and ahead of everything else at the desk.

## What happens

The pre-commit gate runs `intent doctor`, and doctor refuses with `residue: install-tree-unknown -- /Users/matts/Devel/prj/Intent -- this dev tree's git cannot be read, so the line names no commit: git diff --quiet 128c58669c18... fails with "bad object"`, exit 1, so the commit is refused. Only commits from a linked worktree fail; the main checkout's gate passes.

## Measured (vc, 2026-10-25, pair 128c58669)

- A hook run in a linked worktree inherits an absolute `GIT_DIR` from git (eg `/Users/matts/Devel/prj/Molt/.git/worktrees/issue-0060`). Doctor's tree function spawns `git` in the Intent dev tree (`git -C /Users/matts/Devel/prj/Intent ...`) and that spawn inherits the variable, so git reads Molt's repository and cannot find Intent's commit.
- `GIT_DIR=/Users/matts/Devel/prj/Molt/.git git -C /Users/matts/Devel/prj/Intent cat-file -t 128c586` answers `fatal: Not a valid object name`; without the variable it answers `commit`.
- `GIT_DIR=/Users/matts/Devel/prj/Molt/.git intent doctor` reports the install-tree-unknown finding and exits 1; plain `intent doctor` reports 0 findings.
- The main checkout's gate passes only because its `GIT_DIR` is the relative `.git`, which resolves inside whatever tree the spawn runs in, including Intent's.
- The git spawns in intentsvcs: `install.rs`'s `git` helper (ST0087 WP-01, the tree function and the dirty read, the only spawn into the INSTALL tree from a verb that runs in a project), `doctor.rs` near 2402 and 2850, `canon.rs` near 1162, `critic.rs` near 1144 and 1214, and `gitstate.rs` throughout. The project-tree spawns (gitstate, critic's staged read, canon's) run in the project the hook belongs to and must keep the hook's environment, since that is how git finds the worktree's own index; only a spawn into another tree must shed it.

## Expected

A gated commit from a linked worktree behaves as one from the main checkout: doctor reads the install tree's own repository whatever repository the hook was invoked from.

## The fix, specified (vc, 2026-10-25)

One function spawns git into a named tree other than the current repository, and every such spawn calls it: it runs `git -C <root>` with `GIT_DIR`, `GIT_WORK_TREE`, `GIT_INDEX_FILE`, `GIT_COMMON_DIR` and `GIT_PREFIX` removed from the child's environment (`Command::env_remove`), so the child resolves the tree's own `.git` and nothing of the caller's. `install.rs`'s `git` helper is that function or calls it; `doctor.rs`'s calls into the install root go through it; the project-tree spawns stay as they are, with a comment at the one function saying which spawns must not use it and why. No fallback: a tree whose git still cannot be read keeps its finding, now about that tree.

Arms, in intentsvcs' tree-function tests and doctor's, each red at the base: the tree function and the version line asked with a foreign absolute `GIT_DIR` exported (a second scratch repository's `.git`) answer the install tree's commit and dirty state exactly as without it; doctor under the same environment reports no install-tree finding; and the control, a project-tree read under the hook's environment, still sees the worktree's index. Judge: the intentsvcs and intent-cli suites, fmt, clippy, the critic leg; heavy, booked with molt-vc ahead of the other Intent judges; then a build all, since the installed pair is what every gate runs. XS to S. Owner: cc, now. Until the pair carries it, an estate lands worktree work through its main checkout with the full gate, as Molt does, never with --no-verify.
